question: Why did Stellar ship Protocol 24 so soon after Protocol 23, and what was the state-archival bug?

golden.answer: Protocol 24 (2025-10-22) corrected a Protocol 23 bug: eviction loaded an entry's latest TTL but not its latest version, so 478 entries were archived with stale values. CAP-0076 amended the 394 never-restored entries to their correct values and left the 84 restored ones untouched. It also added 31,879,035 stroops to the fee pool for two XLM contract balances that had burned. There was no chain fork.
keyFacts: The bug loaded the latest TTL but not the latest entry version during eviction.
478 entries were corrupted; CAP-0076 amended the 394 never restored.
CAP-0076 added 31,879,035 stroops to the fee pool for two XLM burns; no fork.
avoid: Do NOT say Protocol 24 rewrote all 478 entries or that no funds were affected.

corroboration.claim: The P23 eviction scan checked the latest TTL but failed to reload the latest persistent-entry version, so an arbitrary older Bucket List layer value could enter Hot Archive.
